Corpus Christi, Thu 4 Jun 2026: GPW Benchmark did NOT fix on 4 Jun. There is no WIBOR/WIBID row and no POLSTR/WIRON index date 2026-06-04. Fri 19 Jun 2026 (Juneteenth) is a US-only holiday: GPWB WIBOR and POLSTR, NBP 117/A, EURIBOR, PRIBOR, BUBOR and a Catalyst session all exist for 19 Jun, and by_date['2026-06-19'] is complete. Erste flags for curve agents (levels only; commentary not used). (1) R=5 Jun issue 169489 (C=3 Jun, after Corpus Christi): both headers say 03.06.2026; the WIBOR table, fixing column (NBP 106/A, 4.2433/3.6553), FX session, IRS, FRA and bonds are the 3 Jun close with changes vs 2 Jun (PL chain within 1bp). It contains nothing for 4 Jun. (2) R=8 Jun issue 169491 (C=5 Jun): PL IRS/FRA/bond changes are measured vs 3 Jun (chain OK, PL IRS +4..+9bp over two days), but US and EZ IRS changes are one-day moves vs 4 Jun, when those markets traded: US 1L-5L value minus change is 3-4bp below the 3 Jun value, EZ 10L 5bp; the PL-Bund spread change (+7) is also not a 3->5 Jun change. (3) R=1 Jun issue 169472 (C=29 May): the PL-Bund 10Y spread row (283, +2) is identical to the 29 May issue while its text says PL yields fell 14-18bp with core moves negligible, so that row is stale.
